key_terms.بَيْعَتِي: My allegiance or pledge of loyalty

ai.seo_question: What is Imam Ali's view on justice and his relationship with the Prophet's authority?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) articulates his political and spiritual stance, emphasizing that he elevates the humble and humbles the powerful based on justice. He affirms his sincerity and early acceptance of the Prophet's message, noting that his obedience to the Prophet preceded his political allegiance, yet the political pledge remained a burden on his neck. This passage highlights the Shia concept of 'Amr Bayn al-Amrayn' (the matter between two matters), illustrating how his spiritual priority did not negate his eventual political responsibility, which he viewed as a divine trust rather than a mere worldly gain.

en.sayed-ali-raza: The low is in my view worthy of honour till I secure (his) right for him while the strong is in my view weak till I take (other's) right from him.
We are happy with the destiny ordained by Allāh and have submitted to the command of Allāh.
Do you think I would speak lie about the Prophet of Allāh? By Allāh, I am surely the first to testify him, so I will not be the first to falsify him.
I looked at my affairs and found that my obedience should have precedence over my allegiance while my pledge with him is a burden on my neck.
